tools.name: get_available_task_types
tools.description: Returns the categories of tasks Sherah helps with (indoor and outdoor home, admin, kids, pets, meals, travel, shopping, finances, and more) with example tasks under each. tools.name: request_sign_up
tools.description: Registers a person's interest in signing up for Sherah, without a specific task attached. Sherah emails them a confirmation link; the sign-up only proceeds once they click it, so use this when you have the person's own email address and their agreement to be contacted. tools.name: request_sign_up_with_task
tools.description: Submits a request for Sherah to help with a task, along with the requester's contact and location details. To learn what kinds of tasks Sherah can help with, call get_available_task_types first (or read this server's tasks-we-help-with resource).

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_available_task_types" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
